files.description: Set 'this' for 'type: file' + 'multiple: true'. Use {{ thisName.files }}

for.description: Specify the loop in the format 'variable in collection', for example: 'product in data.products.items'

mask.description: Enter a template in the field where '0' — any digit, 'a' — any letter, '*' — any char, '[]' — make input optional, '{}' — include fixed part in unmasked value, '`' — prevent symbols shift back
